headline: Nifty *rallies 0.5%* as metals shine
subline: Metal and FMCG sectors lift the market higher.
hero_text: The Nifty surged by 0.5%, driven by strong performances in the Metal and FMCG sectors.

why.title: VIX Decline
why.desc: India VIX fell to a 21-session low.

sector_reasons.Nifty Metal: Robust demand led to a 2.4% surge.
sector_reasons.Nifty Health: Held steady with broad market support.

bonus_text: Nifty 500 also advanced, reflecting broader market strength.
movers_note_gainers: BAJFINANCE and HINDALCO led the gains among Nifty 50 constituents.
movers_note_losers: HCLTECH and TITAN saw slight declines, bucking the trend.
watch_text: Watch for USD Unemployment Claims data tomorrow at 22:00 IST.
lessons: Metals boosted market confidence with a strong rise.
FMCG contributed positively to market gains.
A decline in VIX indicated reduced volatility fears.
Institutional buying played a supportive role.
alert_text: USD Unemployment Claims data due tomorrow at 22:00 IST.
